corrections.declared_statement: weighted cycle duality: a feasible potential exists iff no negative cycle exists
corrections.audited_replacement: Weighted L1 quotient optimum: a rational primal upper bound and dual circulation with coordinate bounds certify min_alpha sum_e omega_e |c_e-(d0 alpha)_e| when both feasible objectives agree.
corrections.basis: For a dimension-consistent finite rational instance with nonnegative weights, d0^T w=0 and |w_e|<=omega_e imply w^T c<=sum_e omega_e |c_e-(d0 alpha)_e| for every alpha. Feasible u and equality attain this lower bound. The implementation is not a difference-constraints negative-cycle checker.
limits: Input dimensions and admissible weight conventions remain premises; this correction is not a total malformed-input safety claim.
This finite LP predicate is not an arbitrary QM checker.
